newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian minerals group appoints new chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian minerals group appoints new chief.

text.p: Minerals Council of Australia president Jerry Ellis announced on Thursday the appointment of Dick Wells as executive director.
Wells, who takes up the position in early November, will replace David Buckingham following his departure in August to become Business Council of Australia executive director.

Wells has been the executive director of the Australian Petroleum Production and Exploration Association for the past five years, and prior to that worked as a senior adviser to a number of government ministers.
